newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 24.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on January 24:
WASHINGTON - America Online Inc's flat-rate style of pricing has made it so popular that many of its eight million members cannot connect, giving some users second thoughts.
NEW YORK - PepsiCo Inc directors voted to focus on their beverage and snack businesses and spin off to shareholders the company's nearly 29,000 Pizza Hut, Taco Bell and KFC restaurants.
NEW YORK - A jump in interest rates triggered an avalanche of profit taking, yanking the Dow Jones industrial average back from its first foray above 6,900 points to a loss of nearly 100 points.
WASHINGTON - Network Solutions Inc, the Herndon company that has a near-monopoly on the business of assigning Internet "domains," or addresses, said it is losing money on the enterprise.
